secrets.name: Authorization
secrets.how: not copied; add it under "headers" for this server in .rysh/mcp.json yourself

secrets.name: --api-key
secrets.how: not copied; add the server by hand with ##mcp add, passing the credential from rysh's secret store

secrets.name: URL user info
secrets.how: not copied; add the server by hand without a credential in its URL

secrets.name: token
secrets.how: not copied; add the server by hand without a credential in its URL

secrets.name: FIXTURE_LOG_LEVEL
secrets.how: not copied (no env value is); export it in the shell that starts rysh — MCP servers inherit rysh's environment

secrets.name: FIXTURE_TRACKER_TOKEN
secrets.how: not copied (no env value is); export it in the shell that starts rysh — MCP servers inherit rysh's environment

notes: server "broken" is incomplete (stdio transport requires a command); not imported
server "events" uses the older SSE transport; rysh speaks Streamable HTTP — check the server supports it
server "leaky" passes a credential as an argument (--api-key); not imported
server "leaky-url" has a credential in its URL; not imported
imported MCP servers are written with requires_approval: every tool call is gated until you review the server and remove it
